subject: Pollination Contract Request for Old Mission Growers
body_text:
Hello Meridian Apiaries Team,

I hope this message finds you well! I’d like to request a pollination contract for our blueberry fields. We will need 40 hives, targeting the same blocks as last year. The expected delivery date should align with the blueberry bloom, around mid-April. Additionally, if possible, we would appreciate a split delivery over the bloom period to ensure optimal coverage.

Please send over the contract details at your earliest convenience. If you need any more specifics, feel free to reach out!

Thank you,  
David Douglas Jr.  
Old Mission Growers

subject: Pollination Contract Request for O'Reilly Family Orchards
body_text:
Dear Meridian Apiaries Team,  

I hope this message finds you well! We are gearing up for the upcoming almond bloom and would like to request a pollination contract for 150 hives at O'Reilly Family Orchards. The target site is Block A, and we expect the hives to arrive on February 15, 2024, just as we did last year. If possible, we would appreciate a split delivery to accommodate our timing. Please let me know if you need any additional information to finalize this order.  

Thank you for your assistance!  

Best,  
Tommy Evans

subject: Request for Pollination Contract Details
body_text:
Hi there,  

I hope this message finds you well! I’d like to request a pollination contract for Mountain Valley Orchards to cover our almond segment. We are looking for 30 hives, targeting the northwest block of our orchard. The expected delivery dates are from March 15 to April 5, aligning with last year’s schedule. Please confirm if there are any changes or constraints we should be aware of.  

Thank you for your assistance! Looking forward to your prompt response.  

Best,  
Sara Calhoun

subject: Request for Pollination Contract and Order Details
body_text:
Hello!

I hope this message finds you well. We at Sierra Crest Orchard Partners are looking to finalize our pollination needs for the upcoming almond season. We would like to request a contract specifying 100 hives for our target block, which is located in the central region of our orchard. 

If possible, we'd like to arrange delivery for around the same time as last year, ideally beginning in mid-February. Please let us know if there are any constraints we should be aware of or if you require any additional information to proceed.

Thank you for your assistance!

Best,  
Christina Vargas
